evidence.quote: tad āhur yasyāgnāv agnim uddhareyuḥ kā tatra prāyaścittir iti sa yady anupaśyed udūhya pūrvam aparaṃ nidadhyād yady u nānupaśyet so 'gnaye 'gnivate 'ṣṭākapālam puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye agnināgniḥ samidhyate tvaṃ hy agne agninety āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye 'gnivate svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ

tad āhur yasya gārhapatyāhavanīyau mithaḥ saṃsṛjyeyātāṃ kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye vītaye 'ṣṭākapālam puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye agna āyāhi vītaye yo agniṃ devavītaya ity āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye vītaye svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ

tad āhur yasya sarva evāgnayo mithaḥ saṃsṛjyeran kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye vivicaye 'ṣṭākapālam puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye svar ṇa vastor uṣasām aroci tvām agne mānuṣīr īḍate viśa ity āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye vivicaye svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ

tad āhur yasyāgnayo anyair agnibhiḥ saṃsṛjyeran kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye kṣāmavate 'ṣṭākapālam puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye akrandad agni stanayann iva dyaur adhā yathā naḥ pitaraḥ parāsa ity āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye kṣāmavate svāheti sa tatra prāyaścittiḥ

tad āhur yasyāgnayo grāmyeṇāgninā saṃdahyeran kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye saṃvargāyāṣṭākapālam puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye kuvit su no gaviṣṭaye mā no asmin mahādhana ity āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye saṃvargāya svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ

tad āhur yasyāgnayo divyenāgninā saṃsṛjyeran kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye 'psumate 'ṣṭākapālam puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye apsv agne sadhiṣ ṭava mayo dadhe medhiraḥ pūtadakṣa ity āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye 'psumate svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ

tad āhur yasyāgnayaḥ śavāgninā saṃsṛjyeran kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye śucaye 'ṣṭākapālam puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye agniḥ śucivratatama ud agne śucayas tavety āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye śucaye svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ

tad āhur yasyāgnaya āraṇyenāgninā saṃdahyeran kā tatra prāyaścittir iti sam evāropayed araṇī volmukaṃ vā mokṣayed yady āhavanīyād yadi gārhapatyād yadi na śaknuyāt so 'gnaye saṃvargāyāṣṭākapālam puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet tasyokte yājyānuvākye āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye saṃvargāya svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ

tad āhur ya āhitāgnir upavasathe 'śru kurvīta kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye vratabhṛte 'ṣṭākapālam puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye tvamagne vratabhṛc chucir vratāni bibhrad vratapā adabdha ity āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye vratabhṛte svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ

tad āhur ya āhitāgnir upavasathe 'vratyam āpadyeta kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye vratapataye 'ṣṭākapālam puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye tvam agne vratapā asi yad vo vayam pramināma vratānīty āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye vratapataye svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ

tad āhur ya āhitāgnir amāvāsyām paurṇamāsīṃ vātīyāt kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye pathikṛte 'ṣṭākapālam puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye vetthā hi vedho 'dhvana ā devānām api panthām aganmety āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye pathikṛte svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ

tad āhur yasya sarva evāgnaya upaśāmyeran kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye tapasvate janadvate pāvakavate 'ṣṭākapālam puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye āyāhi tapasā janeṣv ā no yāhi tapasā janeṣv ity āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye tapasvate janadvate pāvakavate svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ

tad āhur ya āhitāgnir āgrayaṇenāniṣṭvā navānnam prāśnīyāt kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapālam puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye vaiśvānaro ajījanat pṛṣṭo divi pṛṣṭo agniḥ pṛthivyām ity āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye vaiśvānarāya svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ

tad āhur ya āhitāgnir yadi pavitraṃ naśyet kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye pavitravate 'ṣṭākapālam puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye pavitraṃ te vitatam brahmaṇaspate tapoṣ pavitraṃ vitataṃ divas pada iti āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye pavitravate svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ

tad āhur ya āhitāgnir yadi hiraṇyaṃ naśyet kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye hiraṇyavate 'ṣṭākapālam puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye hiraṇyakeśo rajaso visāra ā te suparṇā aminantaṁ evair iti āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye hiraṇyavate svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ

tad āhur ya āhitāgnir yadi sūtakānnam prāśnīyāt kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye tantumate 'ṣṭākapālam puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye tantuṃ tanvan rajaso bhānum anv ihy akṣānaho nahyatanota somyā iti āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye tantumate svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ

tad āhur ya āhitāgnir jīve mṛtaśabdaṃ śrutvā kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye surabhimate 'ṣṭākapālam puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye agnir hotā ny asīdad yajīyān sādhvīm akar devavītiṃ no adyety āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye surabhimate svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ

tad āhur ya āhitāgnir yasya bhāryā gaur vā yamau janayet kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye marutvate trayodaśakapālam puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye maruto yasya hi kṣaye 'rā ived acaramā ahevety āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye marutvate svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ
tasya prātaḥ savanīyān anu puroḍāśān agnaye pavamānāyāṣṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapati
evidence.translation: Immediately after the pressing-cakes of the morning-services of this rite he offers a cake, baked on eight kapālas, to Agni Pavamana.

verdict_reason: Every one of the nineteen is the same construction: `so 'gnaye <epithet> N-kapalam purodasam nirvapet` -- 'let him offer to Agni, so qualified, an N-potsherd cake'. The dative is the sutra's own syntax, the accusative names the cake, and the verb is a verb of offering. This is the very pattern the Wave 2 derivation note cites as its justification.
basis: One line of a named ritual work carries this deity in the dative, this offering as a noun, and a verb of offering, with no second theonym-dative and no second offering to pair with; and the line was read.
